about: People bring up a change and who they believe caused it (M4-05). The change comes from an event the speaker learned of; the cause from what they heard: a blame they were told, the record they saw, or, with neither, someone they know holds a public role when their traits lean to blaming authority. Every line is composed from the mined bank (data/english/parts/bring-it-up.json, src/director/mined-words.ts).
